name: Ivan Karelin
source:
The young "Hidden Hero," clad in a ninja/samurai-themed costume and known to act much like a kabuki performer. Ivan rarely takes action and engages himself more in advertising than in actual crime-fighting, appearing in the background of photos and broadcasts to please his sponsors. His shapeshifting ability allows him to copy the appearance and voice of other people, but not their abilities or powers. Ivan is initially a very reluctant hero with insecurities about his "useless" power.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Tiger_%26_Bunny_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
